description: The line plot titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size" illustrates the training loss of different models over a number of steps. The x-axis represents the number of steps, ranging from 0 to 440K, while the y-axis represents the training loss, ranging from 0.0 to 0.85. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model: ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLaMA Medium 20M. The lines are color-coded and have different markers and line styles. The plot shows that the training loss decreases over time for all models, with the ChemBART Small 20M model having the highest initial loss and the ChemLaMA Medium 20M model having the lowest initial loss. The plot also shows that the training loss for all models converges to a similar value as the number of steps increases.
